text: August 18, 2024 - Pirritu (Brett Lee) is an Ngiyampaa musician. His debut album was released in 2021. He is based in Melbourne, Australia. Pirritu was adopted by a non-Aboriginal couple as a newborn, and grew up in Bourke, New South Wales. He was able to later reconnect with his culture when he was 14.
